text: So basically, I want you to be able to detect if a user would paste a prompt that is over 65 characters. And the behavior for this, if you remember well, is that we detect the language for this prompt in order to adapt the dropdown that now displays. Additionally, what I want you to do in this specific scenario, only when people paste a prompt that matches those criteria, not when actually people type, I want you to incredibly change the generate call to action button language to the language of the detected prompt And I want you to shake that button with some animation CSS using a screw of 45 degrees on both sides like a helix maybe. But not like completely rotating, just shaking it from both sides.
